tei:div.tei:p: 245) dbang drag 'bar ba'i dbang bskur gyi zin ris bzhugs so/ 246) gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/

gang zhig rdo rje slob dpon skyed rdzogs kyi nus pa mthar phyin pa dag gis/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus dbang drag 'bar ba'i dbang bskur bar bya ba 'dod na/ de yang gter ston nyid kyi bka' las ni 'di nyid chos bka' bsdus pa'i gdams ngag la dga' ba'i rigs rnams yid ma tshims na gter kha gzhan gyi drag sgrub gang 'os nas kha bskang bar rung mod kyang*/ re shig rang gzhung sor bzhag ltar byed pa'i dbang du bgyi na/ stegs bu'i khar me tog tshom bu lnga sogs ci rigs bkod la/ dbang rdzas ni dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhi ba'i dbang bzhi ltar ram/ yang na gtor dbang bya ste/ 247) dpal gyi gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can zur gsum la me ri dang zhabs su pad 'dab can gzi brjid bag dro ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa bshams pa'i mtha' skor du gtor mchod sman rag tshogs kyi yo byad sogs rgya chen bkod nas/ gu ru zhi drag gi las gzhung bskang gso tshogs gso tshogs mchod rnams rgyas pas bya zhing*/ 'dzab bsnyen ting 'dzin nan tan du sgrub nas slon dpon nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba sogs sngon du bya ba'i rim pa rdzogs pa dang*/ slob ma rnams la khrus dang bgegs skrad bsrung 'khor maṇḍal dang chos bshad kyang*/ gu ru zhi ba'i dbang skabs kyi de ka bshad pas thus la/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa'i dmigs pa 'di ltar sprad de/ 248)om̐ swa bha wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bha wa shuddhanyohaṃ/ skad cig gis khyed rang rnams kyi phung po khams dang skye mched tha mal ya 'thas su 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyang stong nyid khyab gdal chen por gyur pa'i ngang nas/ dregs pa padma zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi rigs pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ dmar me'i mdog can zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/

'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi las nyon gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ gdon bgegs rgyal bsen 'byung po log 'dren gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus/ hūm̐ yig la thim pa tsam gyis gnas 'gyur te/ khyed rang rnams dpal len dbang drag 'bar ba sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis 249) g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkhar 'phyar bas me dang mtshon cha'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ g.yon gnam lcags kyi sdig pa kha dgu mig dgu bco brgyad pa 'jigs su rung ba'i lus las rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med 'gyed pa/ zhal gnam sa tsam du bsgrad cing mche ba gangs ri ltar btsigs pa/ ljags glog dmar ltar 'dril zhing spyan gsum nyi zla ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra ral pa smug nag mun ltar stibs pa la thod skam rin chen rtse bran dar dpyang gis brgyan pa/ sku la dud khrod 'bar ba'i chas brgyad dang dpal gyis chas bcu la sogs khro rgyal rngams pa'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang khyed kyi 'dor stabs can/ sku ri rab lhun po ltar brjid cing 'gying ba'i ba spu'i bu ga kun nas sprul pa'i khro chung gnam sa khengs pa ltar 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i 250) klong na gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor om̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams las 'od zer dang*/ bdag mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs srog las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho nub rnga yab gling na khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dbang drag padma thod phreng gi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ skad cig la sku gzi brjid kyi dpal du 'bar zhing*/ g.yas nas dpal bo 'bum gyi hūm̐ gi glu len/ g.yon nas mkha' 'gro 'bum rdo rje'i gar bsgyur/ mdun du bla ma rig 'dzin gyi tshogs bcas sprin ltar thibs pas byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs/ rgyab nas bka' srung chos skyong gi dpung tshogs nyil ba lta bus ci 'dod kyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i mthu stobs drag po rtsal glog ltar myur ba dang bcas te byon nas/

khyod rang dam tshig sems dpal rnams la mtsho la kha ba 'bab pa bzhin gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa skad cig kyang ma yengs par mdzod cig om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru sarba thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐/ a we sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes rol mo drag tu sgrog pa sogs kyi ye shes bstim zhing*/ su pra tiṣtha badzra ye swā hā/ 1$1000180 zhes me tog gtor bar bstan par rgyas gdab bo/ ༈ de nas dbang dngos ni/ dbang rdzas bum pa'am gtor dbang yin na thog mar slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag pa'i skabs kyi dmigs pa dang dag sbyor rnams bum dbang gi skabs bzhin brjod cing*/ bskur tshig kyang zhi ba'i de ka sor bzhag las/ khyad par ni padma 'byung gnas zhes pa'i skabs su padma drag po sku yi dbang thob shog om̐ āḥhūm̐badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ 1$1000180 zhes bskul zhing*/ de bzhin du mgrin par gsang dbang*/ snying gar sher dbang*/ gnas lnga'am spyi bor tshig dbang dang bcas pa rnams bskur tshul dbang tshig dag sbyor dam tshig bsrung tshul sogs zhi ba'i ji lta ba las/ tshig phrad dang sngags kyi kha bsgyur bar bya'o/ 'di skabs dbang bzhi 252) kho na ma gtogs/ lung dbang dang bka' srung gtor dbang*/ tshe dbang sogs rnams ni mi dgos shing*/ gzhan mjug gi las sogs thams cad spyi ltar shes par bya'o/ mdor na drag sgrub kyi dbang gi rim pa 'di bka' gnyan zhing 'tshub cha che bas na/ slob dpon nyid kyang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin lta sgom man ngag dang ldan dang*/ slob ma yang snod ldan ma gtogs gang byung byung gis ni rung ba ma yin zhing*/ khyad par ding sang gsang sngags 'chal te zang zing 'bul nus kyi zong rin dbang bskur la byed pa dang*/ gsang sngags khrom bshad byed pa 'di 'dras ni slob dpon gnyis kar phan pa bas gnod pa brgya 'gyur gyi che tshul rnams legs par bsam dgos par gda' bas phyi rabs dpyod ldan dag gis dgongs 'tshal/
zhes spong ba sna tshogs rang grol gyis snying nas gsol ba lags/
